root_idea.summary: The root centers on scattering or dispersing something by casting it forth, especially seed.
root_idea.development: The concrete notion of sowing and scattering seed extends to general dispersal, the dissemination of speech, and figuratively the dissipative expenditure of wealth.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested Form II verb is presented under its normalized perfect-tense citation form.
The Quranic plural active participle is presented under the supported singular participial citation form.
The Quran-attested verbal noun is presented as its own lexical form.

senses.definition: To squander or dissipate wealth through extravagant or improper expenditure.
senses.usage_conditions: Form II use with wealth or property; it denotes expenditure beyond what is right or befitting, including consuming, wasting, or ruining what is possessed, rather than ordinary spending.

senses.definition: One who squanders or dissipates wealth through extravagant or improper expenditure.
senses.usage_conditions: Active participle of the Form II expenditure sense; it characterizes a person by such dissipation.

senses.definition: Squandering or dissipating wealth through extravagant or improper expenditure.
senses.usage_conditions: Verbal noun of the Form II expenditure sense; it denotes wasteful expenditure rather than the ordinary dispersal of seed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sow seed or grain by casting it upon the ground; to sow a field.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The basic concrete use; the object may be the seed, grain, or the land being sown.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sow or scatter seed intensively; to scatter or disperse something abundantly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive Form II use related to the concrete scattering of seed, distinct from the Quranic expenditure use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To scatter or disperse a thing; to disperse people across the earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a thing or a group of people; the latter is an attested conventional use, not a restriction on the verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The intensive sowing or scattering of seed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete seed-scattering use of the verbal noun, distinct from its Quranic figurative use for dissipating wealth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disseminate, spread, or diffuse speech among people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative use modeled on scattering seed; the speech may be spread extensively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the earth: to put forth plants, herbage, or seed in a scattered state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive use with the land as subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To divulge what was secret or reveal what one had heard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form I use concerning disclosure of information.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To talk much or be loquacious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verbal use describing excessive talkativeness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become scattered or dispersed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form V use; it can also indicate becoming much scattered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of speech: to become widely disseminated, scattered, or diffused.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative intransitive use with speech or talk as the subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Seed or grain set apart for sowing; any seed or sown grain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may be distinguished from seed of sweet-smelling plants or leguminous herbs in one reported usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A newly emerged plant or herbage just come forth from the earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may refer especially to the first growth while it has only two leaves, or before its kind is fully apparent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Progeny or offspring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative extension from seed to its resulting descendants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disperse in every direction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Fixed expression used of people and, by extension, the like of a man's camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Loquacious; a great or frivolous babbler.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Adjectival use for one who talks excessively or irrationally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food or grain characterized by increase, redundance, exuberance, or abundance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of wheat or other food in which there is abundant increase.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What is false, vain, or ineffectual.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative lexical use associated with the idea of dispersion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who divulges secrets or cannot keep a secret.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Descriptive noun or adjective for a person who reveals confidential information.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calumniator or slanderer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension involving the spreading of damaging speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Scattered or dispersed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The interpretation is disputed; the form is also treated as an imitative or variant expression associated with كثِير, “many.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Increase, redundance, exuberance, plenty, or abundance in wheat or food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions describing food or grain with abundant increase.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The dissipation or squandering of wealth or property in an improper way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal form for wasteful expenditure, synonymous in meaning with the expenditure branch of تبذير.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who dissipates or squanders wealth or property through extravagant expenditure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Agent noun describing a person characterized by consuming, ruining, or improperly spending possessions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land that yields increase or abundant vegetation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Adjectival use with land and its plant growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Many, much, or abundant; blessed with plenty or increase.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of abundant water or other plentiful things.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Concrete sowing and the associated intensive derived forms are represented.
Sowing a field is covered with the seed-scattering branch.
General and intensive scattering are represented.
Dispersing mankind is explicitly included in the general scattering sense.
The intransitive land-and-growth use is represented.
The loquacious Form I use is represented.
Form II dissipation and its verbal noun are Quran-attested.
Seed and newly emerged growth are distinct uses.
The figurative progeny use is represented.
The fixed dispersion expression is represented.
The adjectival loquacity use is represented.
The false, vain, or ineffectual meaning is represented.
The disputed scattered/dispersed interpretation is preserved.
Abundance in wheat or food is represented.
The independent nominal form for improper squandering is represented.
The agent noun for dissipating wealth is represented.
The abundant or plentiful use is represented.

cautions: The Quranic occurrences supplied here are all Form II expenditure derivatives; the seed-sowing, general scattering, and other branches listed separately are broader Classical Arabic evidence.
The interpretation of بَذِيرٌ as “scattered or dispersed” is explicitly disputed in the lexical evidence and is therefore presented with that qualification.
